senses.gloss: to be knocked about, driven off (by the wind).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 68:3">Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 3</cite> <he>היכמא די שְׁקִיף … יִשְׁתּקְּפוּן</he> (not <he>ישקפון</he>) as the smoke is driven, so shall they be driven.
